content:
arjun: Heads-up: our CI started failing after switching to OIDC service tokens in the quickstart pipeline. Local devs using their user keys are fine but CI gets a 403 (payment_required).
emily: can you paste the curl and the exact response?
arjun: here's minimal repro from CI logs:
```bash
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $CI_SERVICE_TOKEN" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/completions" -d '{"model":"gpt-redwood-1","input":"test"}'
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
Content-Type: application/json

{"error":"payment_required","message":"workspace billing consent required for service tokens"}
```
arjun: this happened right after we flipped to short-lived OIDC tokens (rotating). We didn't touch billing settings.
rachel_support: That's our paygate behavior. We recently tightened rules: non-interactive/service tokens require an org billing contact / consent before allowing traffic to protect workspaces from surprise charges. User-scoped keys (interactive) still allowed if the user has billing set up.
emily: ah ok. The quickstart repo uses the service-account CI example and doesn't mention needing to add billing consent. That'll bite a lot of teams.
kevin_sdk: Also noticed the JS SDK in that sample keeps retrying the 403 which floods CI logs. The default retry policy was treating some 4xx as retryable when network flakiness was assumed.
arjun: snippet from our pipeline (node):
```js
const Redwood = require('@redwood/inference');
const client = new Redwood.Client({ apiKey: process.env.CI_SERVICE_TOKEN });
await client.chat.create({ model: 'gpt-redwood-1', input: 'hello' });
// node sdk retried 4x then failed; logs full of 403s
```
kevin_sdk: We pushed an SDK patch that no longer retries on 4xx except 429 and 408. That should reduce noise. We'll cut a patch release this afternoon.
emily: For a hotfix, what's the recommended workaround so our demo CI is green?
rachel_support: Options: 1) temporarily use a personal API key in CI (add to secrets) 2) add billing contact or card to the workspace (recommended) 3) request a short-term whitelist from support — send tenant id and request scope. I can open a ticket for you.
arjun: we'll use option 1 for the demo and switch to proper org billing after. I'll PR README updates to call out the billing consent requirement for service tokens.
kevin_sdk: I'll also add a line in the sample code to set client.retry = { maxRetries: 0 } so users don't get buried in logs while they troubleshoot.
devex-bot: note: sdk/retry-policy-fix deployed to canary (sha: fed9a2).
emily: thanks everyone. rachel, can you open the support ticket and cc me? I'll watch the SDK patch release.
rachel_support: ticket opened (#INC-4821). Will DM tenant id instructions.
arjun: closing the loop: PR with README patch + temporary CI change up in 10m. Thanks :thumbsup:
